children: Company to Showcase Fuel-Free Portable Power at APWA PWX 2026 in Houston and as Part of Canada’s Official Delegation at MSPO 2026 in Poland
Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - August 28, 2026 – Hybrid Power Solutions Inc.
(FSE: E092) (“Hybrid” or the “Company”), a Canadian developer of portable and hybrid clean power solutions, announces that it will exhibit at two industry events in the coming weeks.
George R. Brown Convention Center, Houston, Texas

PWX is North America’s premier public works conference and the largest gathering of public works professionals on the continent. It connects solution providers with decision-makers across municipalities, infrastructure, and related sectors. Hybrid will showcase its portable and hybrid clean power solutions for public works, emergency response, and critical infrastructure applications.

Hybrid is an official exhibitor at the International Defence Industry Exhibition (MSPO 2026) in Kielce, Poland, one of Central and Eastern Europe’s leading defence industry exhibitions and Europe’s third-largest defence and security trade show. The Company will present its portable, battery-based energy storage systems for defence, emergency response, and mission-critical applications, including silent, low-signature, modular power solutions that reduce fuel dependence and logistical burden in deployed environments.

Hybrid’s participation is part of Canada’s official MSPO 2026 program, administered by the Trade Commissioner Service. Canada is the Lead Nation for the 2026 edition, and the program supports export-ready Canadian defence and security companies targeting Poland, Ukraine, NATO partners, and the broader Central and Eastern European market.
Further program details are available at:

These exhibitions give Hybrid direct access to municipal decision-makers and defence procurement audiences, supporting lead generation, partner development, and market expansion for its portable and hybrid clean-power systems in public works, emergency response, and mission-critical defence applications.

Hybrid Power Solutions Inc. is a Canadian clean energy innovator listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange under the symbol "HPSS." The Company specializes in developing portable power systems that eliminate the need for fossil fuels in off-grid and remote applications. With a focus on environmental responsibility and technological innovation, Hybrid Power Solutions is committed to leading the clean energy transition.
